title: Daily Reading Articles Automation
description: This project automates the process of compiling and sending three selected journal articles via email. It uses a Python script along with a Jupyter notebook to collect content (via the `jim_donovan_journals.py` and `main.py` files) and then dispatch it to the user’s inbox. The workflow relies on standard Python libraries and email automation, supported by a configuration file (`pyproject.toml` + `requirements.txt`) and a simple batch script to trigger execution. It is designed for scheduled, recurring delivery of curated reading material.
